name: powershell
smoke: if ($PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString() -ne '7.6.9') { throw 'incorrect PowerShell version' }; if ([System.Runtime.InteropServices.RuntimeInformation]::FrameworkDescription -ne '.NET 10.0.14') { throw 'incorrect .NET runtime' }; foreach ($name in @('PowerShellGet','PackageManagement','Microsoft.PowerShell.PSResourceGet','Microsoft.PowerShell.Archive','PSReadLine','Microsoft.PowerShell.ThreadJob')) { if (-not (Get-Module -ListAvailable -Name $name)) { throw "missing bundled module $name" } }
